## Logger.isInfoEnabled property

Check if the `info` messages are output.

**Signature:**

```typescript
get isInfoEnabled(): boolean;
```

## Remarks

Use it to skip an expensive preparation of the message when the message would not be output.

In the preliminary state it returns `true`<!-- -->, so that the messages produced under the check are buffered (see `hasLevel`<!-- -->).

<ul> <li>added in v7.0.0, as the new name of <code>isInfo</code></li> </ul>
